error_decomposition.conclusion: A uniform logit shift explains about50% of baseline step7 and85% of runtime step1 squared error, but runtime step7 retains centered relative RMSE0.03222268. Shifts do not explain all failures; original raw-logit gates remain failed.

scratch_lifetime.semantics: One TemporaryFile per process; mappings share its single unlinked inode. The inode is reclaimed after the last mmap/fd disappears at process exit. No original weights, GGUFs or metrics are removed.

q4k_exit_recovery.limit: Other concurrent builds also write files; free-space delta is not an isolated benchmark. The exited process has zero fd and its unlinked scratch inode is no longer retained.
